evidenceLayout: tmp/me-middle-20260925-s175/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ holds pre-edit-hashes.txt, intent.md, post-edit-hashes.txt and final-hashes.txt (tmp is gitignored). Cargo logs go to target/fe-logs/<plan>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log per design 6.5.7.
logRule: Design 6.5.7: every cargo run writes a new target/fe-logs/<plan>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log (S = Riela session number; n counts from 1 per check within the session; never overwrite). Run each cargo command as (set -o pipefail; CMD 2>&1 | tee LOG); echo "exit=$?" >> LOG. The progress log cites the counting log path and its exit= value, and for nextest and cargo test the run and passed counts (run > 0). A missing log, a log without exit=, or a truncated log fails the check. 'LOG(<plan>-<check>): CMD' in the verification arrays means CMD run under this rule.

commonContract.editProtocol: vactrol-middle-masks.md section 'Edit Protocol (common to every ME plan)': fresh read and sha256 before each edit, intent snapshot before each sharedPath edit, post-edit hash, stop and reapply on drift, keep the tree compiling, never edit files outside writePaths/sharedPaths, rustfmt on owned files only, no git reset/clean/stash/checkout, no branches or worktrees, no commits, final-hashes.txt at the end.
commonContract.gateContract: The step6-implement output payload carries planId. The test-integrity and adversarial-review outputs carry NO planId and always carry a findings array (empty when there are none).
commonContract.parallelSafety: ME-CHECK, ME-VM and ME-PATTERN run in the same working directory at the same time (and ME-REACTIVE may overlap ME-CHECK/ME-PATTERN). Their writePaths and sharedPaths are disjoint. A build error in another plan's file is waited out and recorded, never fixed by the observer; serial repair happens at the join (reconcile step) and in ME-INTEGRATE.
commonContract.commitPolicy: The source tree stays uncommitted until the workflow commit step. The plan/design checkpoint commit (before fanout) stages by explicit path only: design-docs/specs/, design-docs/user-qa/, impl-plans/active/, impl-plans/README.md, and tests/fixtures/spec/manifest.toml (it changed together with lang-reference.md line 783 and design-music.md block 2; without it verbatim_cases_appear_in_their_document fails at the checkpoint HEAD). It never stages src/, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock. The single implementation commit on main uses the six CLAUDE.md sections on separate lines and no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By line; its staging list is in vactrol-middle-finalize.md.
commonContract.normativeDesign: design-implementation.md 5.6, 6.5.8, 7.1 and 10.1 are normative. Where a plan and the design differ, the design wins and the difference goes in that plan's progress log.

issueReference.title: Implement the language middle end: checker, namespace/compiler/VM, pattern engine (TASK-004..006)

constraints: Implement exactly the TASK-004/005/006 deliverables and completion criteria in impl-plans/active/vactrol-core.md. design-implementation.md 5.6, 6.5.8, 7.1 and 10.1 are normative and win over the plans.
Rust names follow the design type names. Files at 800+ lines are split, with a hard limit of 1000 lines (CLAUDE.md).
No new crate dependencies and no panics on untrusted input. Host I/O for load/sample stays behind NoopHost.

Cargo runs with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true and writes one complete log per command under target/fe-logs/ with exit= recorded. Evidence lives under tmp/me-middle-20260925-s175/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ (gitignored).

Every plan verification includes plain CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true cargo test in addition to nextest. The step6 output carries planId. The test-integrity and adversarial-review outputs carry findings and no planId.

The source tree stays uncommitted until the workflow commit step. There is a single implementation commit on main, pushed, with the six CLAUDE.md sections on separate lines and no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By line.
Secret-dependent commands run through kinko exec. No secret values are committed.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Q1 parent-scope model (author, 2026-09-25). The scope chain is prelude -> session -> fn/block. Same-scope rebinding is an error. Shadowing a prelude name is a hint, shadowing a user-defined parent name is a warning, and the prelude is read-only. Sources: lang-reference.md section 4 and the design-music.md sound kits section.

path/url literal types: Nix-style unquoted paths containing /, and scheme:// urls. They are resolved relative to the containing file, which needs a front-end amendment (ME-FRONTEND). load path evaluates the file in a fresh child scope of the prelude and returns its last expression.
default-sound-kit and sound-kit are prelude bindings. s resolves keywords against the late-bound sound-kit, so the keyword set check follows the current kit value instead of a fixed host set.

SOUND FIRST: a chain starts with s <sound>, and n/note [..] > s :x is a checker error. First-structure rule: the first list-valued step defines the structure, later list controls are sampled at the existing onsets, and s [..] is structured from the start.
Destination/source model: instruments (builtin, inst, MIDI out via s {midi 1}) are destinations. Sources are step lists, midi-notes (after s) and signals. d1..d9 are the only sinks.

M1 overloads scale/shape on the subject type. M2 makes range subject-first. M3 makes inst header parameters control names. Q3 names Tidal struct as grid. Q4 keeps both gain and amp. Chord qualities are letter-first keywords (:dom7, never :7).
U5: the checker diagnoses a bare field-less enum variant used as a binding pattern in if/match. This obligation is carried over from the expander.
Late domain parameters (design-implementation.md 5.5): osc {* 20 {sin time}} keeps its thunk alive and forces it once per resolve_uniforms. osc is all-Late.
intentionalTradeoffs: Host I/O for load/sample, the slot table, the scheduler and staging invalidation are deferred to TASK-007..010. NoopHost stubs keep the middle end testable now.

The wave DAG is MASKS -> FRONTEND -> {CHECK, VM, PATTERN} -> REACTIVE -> INTEGRATE -> FINAL, sequenced only where source dependencies force it. types/masks.rs comes first because the compiler consumes it.

Plans have disjoint writePaths. Shared files (types/mod.rs, ns/mod.rs, vm/mod.rs, lib.rs) are owned sequentially. The pre/post sha256 edit protocol applies, serial repair happens in ME-INTEGRATE, and crate-wide fmt runs only in ME-FINAL.

Open user-QA items M4 (an unstructured sound at a sink plays one event per cycle) and M5 (# ends a url) follow the recommendations. M6 (two let sound-kit lines in one design-music block) is deferred and not pinned.
The TASK-006 11.3 staging-invalidation clause is evidenced only at the re-query level. ME-FINAL notes this or leaves the box unchecked (accepted residual risk).
ME-VM and ME-REACTIVE may need several sessions (accepted residual risk).
supportedEdgeCases: Same-scope rebinding (error), prelude shadow (hint), user-parent shadow (warning), and writes to the read-only prelude.
The path forms ./x ../x ~/x /abs/x and scheme:// urls. # ends a url (M5).
n [..] > s :x and note [..] > s :x are rejected. s [..] is structured from the start. A single-sound subject has no structure. midi-notes is a structure-giving step after s.
Rebinding sound-kit changes the keyword set that s sees (late-bound).
A bare field-less enum variant used as a binding pattern in if/match (U5).
A Late thunk is not forced at the call boundary and is forced once per resolve_uniforms at two frame times (real osc, through ME-INTEGRATE).
Pattern goldens, sample-region cover equivalence, forcing masks and reactive propagation.
Chord keywords: [:g :7] stays a negative lexer case (src/reader/tests/lexer.rs:90) and [:g :dom7] is the verbatim positive case.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real file and sample I/O, package loading, DSP output, and scheduler and slot-table behavior (TASK-007..010).
M6 (multiple let sound-kit lines in one block) and the two open authority questions.
reviewContext.userProblem: Issue #2: implement the Vactrol language middle end (TASK-004 checker, TASK-005 namespace/compiler/VM/tweak slots/reactive graph, TASK-006 pattern engine/signals/clock/visual chains) from impl-plans/active/vactrol-core.md, plus the 2026-09-25 amendments: parent-scope shadowing, path/url literals with load/sample, the sound-kit prelude bindings with the kit: argument, SOUND FIRST with the first-structure rule, midi-notes after s, and the U5 checker diagnostic.
requiredOutcomes: Every TASK-004, TASK-005 and TASK-006 completion criterion in vactrol-core.md is checked with evidence, and the statuses are COMPLETED (ME-FINAL).
Spec fixtures type-check, compile and run per their classification through read -> expand -> check -> compile -> run (ME-INTEGRATE).
Pattern goldens, sample-region cover equivalence, forcing-mask and reactive-propagation cases pass as tests (ME-PATTERN, ME-VM, ME-REACTIVE).
The checker rejects n [..] > s :x and note [..] > s :x; U5 is diagnosed; same-scope rebinding is an error; a prelude shadow is a hint and a user-parent shadow is a warning (ME-CHECK).
path/url literals are read, have Value variants and are typed; load path and sample path type-check with host I/O behind NoopHost (ME-FRONTEND, ME-CHECK, ME-REACTIVE).
Build, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, nextest, cargo test and both wasm32 builds exit 0 on the final tree (ME-FINAL).
nonGoals: TASK-007..010: slot table, scheduler, staging invalidation, layer-2 dedup, hosts, file and sample I/O, DSP, package loading, session/REPL/LSP, editor.
Answering the open user-QA items M4-M6 or the two authority questions; the recommendations are followed and pinned.
decisionsNotToReopen: Q1 parent-scope model; path/url literal types; default-sound-kit/sound-kit and the kit: argument; M1-M3; SOUND FIRST and the first-structure rule; MIDI out is an instrument and d1..d9 are the only sinks; destination/source model; Q3 grid; Q4 gain and amp; letter-first chord keywords.
openUserQa: M4 unstructured sound at a sink plays one event per cycle (followed).
M6 two let sound-kit lines in one design-music block (block deferred; not pinned).
carriedFindings: Step 3 low finding: the manifest edits of the design-doc step (three import cases rewritten sound-first; design-music block 2 stray-char@37) were not verified by cargo because the design sandbox could not run cargo.
